title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Which of these is part of the context window the model reads on every call of the makerspace assistant?

options.text: The full text of every manual the assistant could search
The tool definitions, such as the description of check_calendar
Every earlier student's conversation from previous sessions
The program's Python code that actually runs each tool

items.stem: A student finishes a session and closes the chat. Which design lets the assistant know their preferred booking time at the next session?

options.text: Write a short note to a file, and load it at the next session's start
Trust the model to remember the student from the earlier chat
Choose a model with a larger context window for the assistant
Lengthen the system prompt so it describes every possible student

items.stem: In one session, the system prompt plus tool definitions total 1,000 tokens and the student's question is 100. Call 1 ends with a 50-token tool request; the tool result is 350 tokens. Call 2 writes a 200-token answer. The student then sends a 100-token follow-up, which triggers call 3. Each call's input is everything in the window so far. What is the total number of input tokens across the three calls?
The assistant's search returns generic pages for the query "fault E-47" and misses the one page that lists that exact code. Which change best fixes this?

options.text: Add keyword matching, such as BM25, and merge it with the semantic results
Return many more chunks per search so the right page is in there
Place every manual into the system prompt for every request
Tell the model in the prompt to understand the meaning better

items.stem: In a long session your assistant clears old tool results to keep the window small. The student's confirmed booking time appeared only in a result that was cleared, and the assistant later forgets it. What design change prevents this?

options.text: Switch to a model whose context window is much larger
Stop clearing results and let the window fill to its limit
Tell the model in the system prompt to remember all results
Save key facts to notes before the results are cleared
